alex_cheng: Heads-up, we have a new customer org to onboard across AWS + GCP for GPU workloads. Need a concise checklist for account/project setup + quota requests. Who's got the canonical steps?

maria_kaplan: I'll paste the checklist I use. Short version first, then templates.

maria_kaplan: Checklist:
1) Org & billing: create org node + link billing account. Ensure billing export to BigQuery/S3.
2) Tagging policy: enforce tags: 'redwood:team', 'redwood:env', 'cost-center', 'project'.
3) IAM: create infra-admins group; minimal privileges for engineers; dedicated infra service accounts with least privilege.
4) Network: shared VPC(s) in chosen regions, private subnets for nodes, enable flow logs.
5) Firewall/NAT: restrict inbound, centralize NAT egress, size NAT gateway / SNAT pools for expected egress.
6) Quotas: request GPU quotas (A100/T4), regional vCPU, External IPs/Elastic IPs, ENI limits, NAT throughput.
7) KMS/HSM: provision customer-managed keys and grant infra SAs encrypt/decrypt.
8) Observability: enable audit logs, CloudWatch/Stackdriver, billing export, and cost alerts.
9) Policies: org policy to restrict locations and enforce disk encryption.
10) Cost controls: budgets, alerts, and tag-based allocation.

maria_kaplan: GCP GPU quota request template:
```
Project: projects/123456789
Quota target: GPUs (A100) in region us-central1
Current quota: 0
Requested quota: 8 A100 GPUs
Justification: Production inference capacity for Redwood customer. Expected sustained 50 QPS across 4 hosts with redundant pods. We have budgeting and autoscaling controls in place.
Contact: infra@redwood.com / account manager name
Preferred start date: 2026-04-01
```
Subject suggestion: "Quota increase request - GPUs - projects/123456789 - Redwood Inference"

samir: AWS support case template (include cost center, architecture diagram):
```
Account: 987654321012
Limit: On-Demand instance limit for instance family p4/p3/g4 in us-west-2
Requested: 4 x p4d / alternative 8 x g4dn (fallback)
Justification: Low-latency inference endpoints for paying customer. Provide expected steady-state hours and estimated monthly spend.
Attachments: small architecture diagram + expected traffic profile (QPS, avg tokens)
Contact: infra@redwood.com, Slack: #eng-infra
```
Notes: mention preferred AZs and ask for soft-limit bump to avoid hard denies.

jia_liu: Networking reminders: raise regional External IP quota (GCP) and Elastic IP / ENI quotas (AWS). Also check VPC peering and Cloud Router quota. If using private clusters, increase routes quotas and node-pool instance limits.

infra-bot: NOTE: quota requests typically take 48-72h. Use account manager for expedited review.

ops-oncall: Quick ops checklist: create budget alert at 3x expected daily spend, add Slack alert to #billing-alerts, attach tags to all infra resources so chargeback works.

alex_cheng: Action items: @samir file AWS case, @jia_liu file GCP quota request, @maria_kaplan draft IAM & tag policy, @ops-oncall set budget alerts. Post the support case numbers here when created.
